data.notes: Focused on confirmed ticket/listing pages for underground club nights, open-air parties, techno/house brands and diaspora-adjacent events; obvious arena shows are omitted.

events.title: Musikfest Berlin 2026
events.venueName: Philharmonie Berlin, Konzerthaus Berlin, Haus der Berliner Festspiele and Deutsche Oper Berlin
events.summary: Berliner Festspiele and the Berliner Philharmoniker Foundation present Musikfest Berlin 2026 from 28 August to 23 September, opening with Ligeti’s Le Grand Macabre and featuring major international orchestras, choirs, ensembles and soloists.

events.title: Pop-Kultur Festival 2026
events.venueName: Silent Green, Festsaal Kreuzberg, Kulturbrauerei and Pierre Boulez Saal
events.summary: Pop-Kultur’s 2026 programme runs 24–30 August, with confirmed live listings including Bar Italia, Jassin, The Notwist, Avalon Emerson & the Charm, PVA and múm.

events.title: Young Euro Classic 2026
events.summary: International youth orchestra festival at Konzerthaus Berlin, with 17 evening concerts, 14 youth orchestras, two jazz ensembles and a chorus across the 2026 edition.

events.title: MAGMA Festival | 08. & 09. August 2026
events.summary: Second edition of MAGMA at RSO.BERLIN, pairing house, techno, bass and forward club music with Joy Orbison, Yaeji, DJ Travella, Anthony Naples, HiTech, Mia Koden, Doudou MD and more.

events.title: West-Eastern Divan Orchestra, Daniel Barenboim & Yo-Yo Ma
events.summary: The West-Eastern Divan Orchestra’s traditional Waldbühne concert features Daniel Barenboim and cellist Yo-Yo Ma, with Dvořák’s Cello Concerto and orchestral repertoire on the programme.

events.title: The Village Festival Berlin - House of Lunacy & The Extended Luniverse
events.summary: House of Lunacy expands into a 24-hour, two-venue immersive art, performance and music festival spanning Club OST and Renate with a strict costume concept and sex-positive framework.

events.title: MAGMA Festival 2026
events.summary: MAGMA returns to RSO.BERLIN for a two-day open-air edition across VALLEY and OPAN, with Joy Orbison, Yaeji, Erika de Casier, Skin On Skin, The Dare, HiTech and more listed by Resident Advisor.

events.title: AnnenMayKantereit – Live 2026
events.summary: AnnenMayKantereit are confirmed for three Berlin evenings at Parkbühne Wuhlheide on 13, 14 and 15 August 2026 as part of their Live 2026 tour.

events.title: Escalation Fest – Berlin Edition: Electric Callboy
events.summary: Electric Callboy bring Escalation Fest – Berlin Edition to Parkbühne Wuhlheide as an open-air event, with doors at 13:00 and showtime at 15:00.

events.title: Deftones – Summer 2026
events.summary: Deftones play an open-air Berlin date at Parkbühne Wuhlheide on 18 August 2026, with doors at 16:00 and showtime at 18:00.

events.title: BCCO x HIVE
events.summary: A post–Rave The Planet collaboration between BCCO and HIVE at DSTRKT, focused on techno and trance with lineup still TBA.

events.title: SYNOID
events.summary: A confirmed August edition of Berlin techno institution SYNOID at ÆDEN, currently listed with full details to follow.

events.title: Else 13th Birthday Weekender: 40 hours nonstop
events.summary: Else marks its 13th birthday with a 40-hour open-air and club weekender featuring Blue Hour, Kameliia, Len Faki, Matrixxman, nthng, Stephanie Sykes, Vincent Neumann and more.

events.title: Polyamor X GOAT BALL 34h Weekender
events.summary: Polyamor and GOAT BALL join forces for a 34-hour Lokschuppen weekender spanning trance and techno with a broad local-and-underground lineup.

events.title: Else x DJ Gigola pres. Bigroom Sensual
events.summary: DJ Gigola brings the Bigroom Sensual concept to Else for a Sunday open-air and indoor session with DJ Babatr, LB aka LABAT, LYZZA, SWART, ALCATRAZ b2b Margo XS and Luke Hovey.

events.title: Else x Nachti
events.summary: Nachtdigital’s Nachti spirit lands at Else for a long Sunday open-air and club session with Courtesy, Dahmar, Danielle, DJ MILLE, Elias Mazian, Jenny Cara and Moopie.

events.title: Kraftklub – “Sterben in Karl-Marx-Stadt” Tour 2026
events.summary: Kraftklub are listed for two sold-out Parkbühne Wuhlheide shows on 21 and 22 August 2026 on the “Sterben in Karl-Marx-Stadt” tour.

events.title: Alligatoah – 20 Jahre Jubiläumskonzert
events.summary: Alligatoah plays the second Berlin date of his 20-year anniversary concert run at Parkbühne Wuhlheide, with doors at 17:00 and showtime at 19:00.

events.title: OMD – Summer of Hits
events.summary: Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark play Zitadelle Spandau with support from Zoot Woman as part of OMD’s Summer of Hits open-air run.

events.title: Havelbeats Festival 2026
events.summary: Two-day Havelbeats Festival in Potsdam’s Schiffbauergasse/Waschhaus area on 7 and 8 August 2026; the venue page says artist and ticket details will follow via the festival site.
